source.revision_note: The complete local Hugging Face snapshot and refs/main prove this Windows conversion source revision. The separate MLX training machine did not record its exact revision, so equivalence to the trained model's source revision is not claimed.

adaptation.note: Unmodified upstream base weights from the recorded local snapshot.

export_provenance.note: Converted locally to F16 with the recovered official b10256 converter, then quantized by b10256 to Q4_K_M. The qwen module omits only unsupported optional DFlash/DSpark registrations because published gguf 0.19.0 lacks MODEL_ARCH.DFLASH; the standard Qwen3 tensor mapping is unchanged and the adapted module hash is frozen here.

limitations: The exact upstream revision used on the MLX training machine is unknown; only the repository name and intended pipeline are evidenced.

notes: CHAT-02B comparable base asset. No model download was required because the complete source snapshot was already in the local Hugging Face cache.
